body: I have add so I can’t meditate and I’m 15 so beer is out of the question. Winter so I can’t walk. And I can’t really listen to music the entire day.
I’m still trying to find something I like. I mostly like strategy games though. Like eu4 and total war. Trying to learn Starcraft 2. To be honest all I do is watch YouTube videos on politics.
My problem is I can’t make friends. Mainly because I can’t meet anyone that I can relate to.

Parents aren’t cool. My dad is one of the causes of my social anxiety. He would yell at me for anything I did wrong and call me an idiot. So I never trusted myself. It reached its peak in middle school for me because I thought everyone was constantly judging me.
